description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget for the 'note detail' screen in a note-taking app. It manages creating, editing, and deleting notes, including UI components for note metadata such as category and color, as well as text editing for the note's title and content.

classes.name: NoteDetailScreen
classes.description: A stateful widget representing the detailed view for creating or editing a note.

classes.name: _NoteMetaBar
classes.description: A stateless widget that provides UI for selecting note category and color.

classes.name: _NoteEditor
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays text fields for editing note title and content.

classes.name: _DotDivider
classes.description: A simple widget rendering a small circular dot used as a separator.

methods.name: _load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads a note's data if editing an existing note, and updates the state accordingly.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the screen, including app bar, floating action button, and body with note editing UI.
